newsitem.title: USA: US FERC grants NYSEG tariff, notice waiver.
newsitem.headline: US FERC grants NYSEG tariff, notice waiver.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Wednesday accepted a proposed tariff for New York State Electric and Gas Corp to provide economic development power from a state-owned generating plant to specific retail customers under a state program.
The commission also granted a waiver of jurisdiction to let the tariff be effective without modification as of the date sales started in 1994.
But the commission said any transactions with new retail customers or revisions to arrangements with existing customers must meet requirements of FERC's Open Access Rule.
NYSEG had claimed that the activity was outside FERC's oversight because the utility makes bundled retail sales under the tariff.

But FERC disagreed, and said NYSEG engages in unbundled retail transmission in interstate commerce with the program, which is an effort to allocate surplus power to businesses to expand investment and employment in the state.
